messages:
mia: deploy-bot started a eu canary for v2026.03.28 at 10%. quick note: release notes in the PR mention a revert to v2026.03.20 binary. is that intentional?

deploy-bot: deploy event: v2026.03.28-canary -> service/inference-eu (traffic=10%). run: https://deploys.redwood/1745009999

eli: that sounds off. build metadata shows model variant v2026.03.28 + runtime v3.14. the release notes referencing v2026.03.20 binary could confuse oncall during rollback.

ops_lead: agree, we should STOP ramp until release notes and changelog are consistent. also pin traffic to 0% in eu while we confirm. don't want accidental wrong rollback.

sre_oncall: seeing a small p95 uptick but nothing critical. safety first: stop and pin until docs match.

mia: propose: STOP rollout -> set canary traffic to 0% -> update release notes to clarify model vs runtime versions -> then decide resume at 5% or proceed. all in favor?

deploy-bot: action: traffic update requested by mia. setting v2026.03.28-canary traffic to 0% in eu-west. (id=rb-1745009999-01)

eli: I'll push a docs patch to the release notes now and tag the run. also adding explicit rollback playbook note: "if rollback required, revert runtime to v3.13 not model to v2026.03.20"

ops_lead: thanks. once docs updated, we'll re-evaluate. if infra looks good, attempt 5% test with manual oversight.

sre_oncall: sounds good. keeping an eye on latency and error budget. reopen thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
